scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.test:contracts: npm run build:contracts && vitest run tests/contracts
scripts.test:consumers: npm run build:contracts && vitest run tests/consumers
scripts.test:consumer:ui: npm run build:contracts && vitest run tests/consumers/ui-contract.test.ts
scripts.test:consumer:api: npm run build:contracts && vitest run tests/consumers/api-contract.test.ts
scripts.test:api: npm run build:contracts && vitest run tests/api
scripts.build:api: npm run build:contracts && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.build.json && node tools/strip_build_sourcemaps.mjs
scripts.test:core: npm run build:contracts && vitest run packages/core/src
scripts.test:web: npm run build:contracts && vitest run apps/web/src
scripts.build:web: npm run build:contracts && vite build --config apps/web/vite.config.ts
